_comment: LBNL FDD Fan-Power Unit (FPU; parallel PFPU / series SFPU) point -> CAMBER Role mapping. Faults are imposed in the SOUTH zone (column suffix _S): diffing each faulted run against PFPU_FaultFree shows the changed columns are RH_*_S / VAV_*_S, so the _S box is the device under test (the _E/_I/_W zones stay healthy; until 0.82.0 this mapping pointed at _W and scored a healthy box). The reheat valve is the controller DEMAND (RH_VLV_DM_S), not the measured position: the drift detector reads how far the controller has to open the valve, and a stuck or leaking valve's position is exactly what the controller cannot see. VAV_DMPR_S has no demand twin in this dataset, so it is the position. The reheat dT for the reheat-valve detector is VAV_DAT_S (leaving, warm) minus the AHU supply SA_TEMP (entering the box, cool). Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY).
